name: GDPR (EU General Data Protection Regulation)
description: Core obligations for processing personal data of EU data subjects.

rules.title: Lawful basis for processing
rules.requirement: The document must identify a valid lawful basis for processing personal data (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interests).

rules.title: Valid, withdrawable consent
rules.requirement: Where consent is the basis, it must be freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous, and as easy to withdraw as to give.

rules.title: Data subject rights
rules.requirement: The document must describe how data subjects can exercise their rights: access, rectification, erasure ('right to be forgotten'), restriction, and data portability.

rules.title: 72-hour breach notification
rules.requirement: There must be a process to notify the supervisory authority of a personal data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware of it.

rules.title: Data minimization & purpose limitation
rules.requirement: Personal data collected must be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary, and processed only for specified, explicit, legitimate purposes.

rules.title: International transfer safeguards
rules.requirement: Transfers of personal data outside the EEA must be covered by appropriate safeguards (adequacy decision, Standard Contractual Clauses, or Binding Corporate Rules).

rules.title: Data protection contact / DPO
rules.requirement: The document should provide the identity and contact details of the data controller and, where required, the Data Protection Officer.
